balls.text: drags the full delivery to the on side and he will come back for the second run.
shuffles across to the off and tries to swing it over backward square-leg but ends up getting too much under the ball and scoops it up but clears short fine-leg
full and well outside off, KP reaches out to slice it to deep point region
fuller, on the middle, dug out towards long-on
length delivery, hit hard but straight to long-off. He should have put that away
fullish outside off stump, driven to cover where Raina fumbles
Finally, KP breaks free with a wallop over long-off. He cleared the front foot and sliced the full delivery over the boundary
back over the wicket, full and outside off, KP has a play and miss ...
from round the stumps, outside off, hits it down to long-off
full toss on the middle and leg, White swat-flicks it over midwicket boundary! Neatly done. Whip of the wrist.
full in length, on the middle, White clears the front foot and heaves it to left of long-off fielder
full delivery outside off, another mistimed off drive
fullish and outside off, mistimes it to midwicket
wide full toss outside off and KP slaps it to the extra-cover boundary
fullish outside off stump, off driven for a single
leans forward to drag a full delivery to long-on
leans forward to force it to long-off
;leans forward to off drive to long-off
flighted off break on the off and middle, White leans forward to swat it over to left of deep midwicket where Gony isn't able to stop it .. a better fielder would have
short in length, breaks away, cut to deep point
leans forward to ease it to long-on
top spinner on the off and middle line, pushed to the off side .. No chance for a single as Dhoni rushes after it
outside off stump, White pushes at it rather tentatively and edges it to the on side
Maiden over from Jakati! It turned from middle and off, pushed back to the bowler. Just two runs from the last two overs. Chennai are applying the squeeze.
quicker around off, square driven to backward point
slower, on the off stump line, defended on the front foot
Kallis is run out It was pushed to right of short straightish extra cover but Raina is too quick to allow that single.. Raina threw the ball to Jakati who does the rest
goes for the sweep , doesn't connect and is hit on the pad
moves down the track, and swats a high full toss to long-on. Enter KP
outside off stump, Kallis goes for the reverse sweep but doesn't connect. Just 2 runs that over.
goes for the sweep to collect a single. Just two runs so far
stretches across to push wide of cover
another skidder outside off, Kallis tries to ping third man but can't connect
skids low outside off stump, Kallis goes for the pull but the ball shoots low ..
lands outside off, Kallis thinks it will spin in but it slides past the outside edge
walks down the track to ondrive to long-on
gets forward to ping Albie at  long-off
around 122 kmph short delivery, Virat waits for it to arrive before pulling it easily to backward square-leg boundary
fullish, driven to left of cover where Raina fumbles. Eighth IPL fifty from Kallis.
wide outside of off stump.
the slower one, very full, dragged to midwicket region
full in length,outside off stump, Virat plays a neat on-the-up punchy shot through covers .. Murali kicks the ball away near the boundary
Kallis gets his third edged four to third man! Full and well outside off, he reached for the big off drive and edges it away
very full delivery, tapped to third man. 100 up.
full in length around off stump, pushed to right of Badri at backward point
slower one outside off stump, Virat is early through with his pull shot and edges it to short fine-leg region
short in length outside off, cut away to deep backward point region for couple of runs ..
slower one outside off, eased wide of backward point
stays back, opens the bat-face and taps it to short third-man region
reaches forward to scoop it past Murali who stretches his right hand out but can't reach the ball
around off stump line, eased towards backward point
quicker, around off and middle, pushed out to the off side
drags it short and Virat opens-up his stance to pull it away to the boundary
leans forward to defend to the on side
moves down the track and turns it towards deep midwicket
leans forward to work it past square-leg
from wide of the crease, pushed to right of the non striker and Jakati makes a fine tumbling save
around off and middle, on a length, driven to short extra cover
on the middle stump line, eased back to the bowler
Another lucky fat edge for Kallis. It was just outside off and Kallis went for the big cover drive but will get a boundary to third man
around 125 kmph full toss on the middle, Kohli whips it away over midwicket boundary. Easy pickings. Two full tosses and both have been put away
length delivery on middle, on driven towards long-on
around 122 kmph low full toss outside off, sliced of the outer edge to third-man boundary
short in length outside off, around 119 kmph, punched to short extra cover
just outside off, driven to left of short cover where the fielder (Badri i think) doesn't stop the ball cleanly
length delivery around off stump, driven to Gony at deep cover
just outside leg stump, on driven towards long-on
skids on towards middle stump line, punched to cover
gets forward to on drive towards mid-on
flighted just outside leg stump line, turned to deep backward square-leg
on the leg stump line, whipped to deep midwicket
just outside off, on a length, Virat rocks back, waits before he cuts past backward point
on the middle stump line, Virat tries to work it to the on side and ends up scooping it uppishly but safely through the unmanned mid-on, down to long-on
around off stump line, steered to point
on the middle and off, turned past square-leg
goes back to clip the delivery from outside off to Raina at midwicket
flighted outside off, Virat edges the on drive to his pad
on the middle and leg, from round the stumps, pushed wide of midwicket
stretches forward to drive to cover
leans forward to defend to the off side
stays back to punch it to sweeper cover

Goes for the slog sweep again but sort of checks it a bit , perhaps Jakati slowed it up a touch or because he shortened the length, and Robin finds the man at deep midwicket. Gony doesn't make any mistake this time.
on the leg stump line, turned past square-leg
goes for the big slog sweep but ends up dragging it along the ground to deep midwicket
full and straight, off driven to mid-off
And this time wide outside off
way too high bouncer .. easy decision to call it a wide
kicks up from short of length around off, tapped to midwicket
Deft! Robin is showing his full range here. He waited for the slower one, a full delivery, opened his bat-face and steered it between backward point and short third-man
slightly slower, square driven to point
Fisted away! What a hit. It was the length delivery just outside off and Robin smoked it on the up and it flies over long-off!
What a slap! Thank you for dropping the catch Gony, he seems to say! It was the short delivery around off and Robin plays a feisty pull. Cracker of a shot. The ball sails flat over midwicket
full delivery, on driven towards mid-on from where Murali fires a direct hit but Robin is home
slightly slower, full and on the leg stump line, flicked past square-leg
really full delivery this time, steered to third man
banged in short but it climbs over Robin, who allows it to sail over him
short in length around off, goes for the pull but doesn't beat midwicket
turns this one to the on side
around the off stump line, dabbed to third man
runs this down to third man
lifting delivery outside off stump line, Kallis tries to play the upper cut but it flies over the blade
banged in short outside off and Kallis flays it with a cracking square cut over point

What a drop by Gony S I T T E R. It was the short delivery, lifting stuff outside off, and this time Robin Uthappa is late on the pull, trying to drag it from outside off and edges a dolly high towards mid-off. Gony settled under it, C Ganapathy too came in from mid-on and in the end it was Gony who came under it and dropped a sitter. What a clanger!
outside off, fuller, dabbed to Murali at third man
Albie fires across a bouncer on middle stump, Kallis doesn't quite get into the perfect position, goes for the pull, seems a touch late on it but ends up dragging it to fine-leg
full in length, moving across Robin who steers to backward point
on the leg and middle, clipped to backward square-leg
tries the short delivery at Kallis, bit of width outside off as well and Kallis slaps it over backward point

Done in by the short delivery, Manish was looking to get forward but Thushara slipped in a short one just outside off, around 127 kmph only but it climbed higher than what Manish seemed to anticipate and he ended up reaching out with an attempted pull and top edged it straight up
pushes to left of Albie at mid-off for  a quick single
in the channel outside off, Kallis tries to guide to third man but is again cramped for room and is beaten

That typical flat-batted hit to the straight boundary from Manish Pandey. He pings long-on or long-off depending on the where the ball is delivered. This one was well outside off and he slapped it between the bowler and mid-off
pushes the back-of-length delivery back down the pitch
flies off from a length, some bounce there, Manish is surprised and just stabs at it .. but doesn't connect
walks down the track and eases it to left of mid-off for a single
gets forward to drive to cover
full in length and straight delivery, no movement and Kallis hangs on the back foot to punch-drive it through extra cover
good tight over this. Short in length and on the off stump line, moving across, steered to point
hangs on the back foot to run down the short-of-length delivery around off to third man
stays back to punch a back-of-length delivery to point
good probing delivery in the channel outside off, bouncing across, Kallis shapes for late cut but is cramped as the ball straightens a bit .. and he is beaten
walks couple of steps down the track, taps the length delivery to the off side and rushes on for a single
in the zone outside of off stump, Manish feels for it , searches for it and is beaten
from round the stumps, a low full toss well outside off, slapped to deep cover
Wallop! What a time to hit a six over cover and what a time to bowl a no ball! He moved outside leg stump and played his favourite hit over cover. Done in style. The crowd erupt!
Badri combusts! It was the short lifting delivery, Dhoni mistimed to midwicket and this time Badri top edges it to backward square-leg and Robin runs across to take the catch
moves right across the sticks and plays a paddle sweep to a length delivery from outside off. Badri screams!
dot ball.  It kicked up from short of length, Badri tried to carve it over point but makes no contact.
full in length around off, uppishly hit towards KP at long-off
full and straight, on driven to long-on
length delivery just outside off, run down to third man
another slow off cutter, Raina was going for the ugly slog across the line and edges it to his pad ..
full in length and outside off stump, Badri edges the square drive to his pad

Cleaned up by the slow off cutter! It landed just outside leg, turned in, Albie pushed out at it, unsure of its destination, the ball slid in to hit the front pad and fell on the stumps! And here we go again. Twist twist twist!
short delivery on the middle, tucked behind square-leg
slower one on the leg, Albie tries to flick, the ball rolls to the off, Kohli rushes in from point and Raina dives to get back inside the crease
short in length, around 146.5 kmph, pushed out to cover point for  a quick single
full in length, on the off stump, punched to left of mid-off where KP makes a fine diving save
shout for a catch down the leg side .. wide signaled. It was full in length and it goes past the attempted glance
fuller, straight, pushed back to Styen
Done in by the short delivery. Dhoni is beaten for pace and by bounce and mistimes the attempted pull .. a simple catch to Dravid at midwicket. Kumble pumps his fist.
slower one, fullish, worked past square-leg for a single
short in length, edges the cut shot to third man
fuller, on the middle and leg, eased to Kumble at midwicket
slower one, off cutter, mistimes the forcing hit .. the ball rolls to midwicket
on the middle stump line, worked through midwicket
pushes this one down the leg side ..
another short delivery, pulled down to Kallis at deep square-leg
banged in short, pulled to deep square-leg

moves outside leg, PK follows him and Raina short-arm pulls it to right of Dravid at deep backward sdquare-leg .. dravid seemed to have got to it as he slides but tries to stop it with his right foot and misses it completely
rushes down the track, Kumble flights it across and Dhoni hits it hard over Kumble for a vital boundary
quicker, bounces, Raina is clueless, has a jab and it rolls off the thigh pad
jumps down the track but is again beaten in flight and lofted hit falls short of long-on..
leg break on the off stump line, Dhoni lunges out, is beaten in flight and squeezes it to cover
moves down the track and drives to KP at long-off
on the off stump line, cut to backward point
another slower one, pushed to long-off
slower one around off stump line, squeezed off the outer edge to PK at backward point
another short delivery, this time Dhoni will collect a single with a pull shot
the bouncer around off stump, slower, Dhoni allows it to pass him
full in length around off, driven to long-off
Super shot. He moved outside leg and lifted the length delivery over covers. It's his signature hit.
around 146.7 kmph short-of-length pacy delivery bouncing over middle stump, too quick for DHoni and he just about manages to stab it unconvincingly to the off side
slower one, short in length on the middle and off line, worked past midwicket
fullish, around off, driven to left of cover where KP makes a diving stop.
around 146 kmph short of length stuff angling away from Raina who runs it to third man
full and fast again, stabbed of the edge to the off side
full in length, around 144 kmph,. skids on towards off stump, jabbed back to the bowler
presses back to work it past square-leg for a single
fuller, on the middle stump line, squeezed back down the pitch
skids on from short of length, pushed back to Anil
on the off and middle line, pushed to point
leg break on middle and leg, squeezed to short fine-leg
lands on a length and skids away from raina who is beaten, trying to late cut it
on the off and middle, tapped to cover point

Vijay falls after an entertaining knock. Will RCB make him rue this shot? Adrenalin rush I guess. He went for another hit over long-on but couldn't connect as well as he wanted and couldn't clear Manish at long-on
leans forward to wrist it wide of midwicket
Thump! KP had slowed up the pace this time, Vijay was again down the track, waited a touch and lifted it from outside off to wide long-on boundary
Vijay is in some hurry here. He rushes down the track to crash this one over long-on. he stands there and admires his shot.
from round the stumps, on the middle and off, pushed towards long-off
fullish on the middle and leg, driven uppishly past the lunging bowler, down to long-on
full in length, on the middle, on driven to long-on
fires in a bouncer just outside off, Vijay top edges the pull over short fine-leg fielder. He has edged two of his pull so far.
short in length, on the leg and middle, shoveled wide of midwicket
pushes it across Raina who is beaten, going for the cut shot
slower one outside off, eased to sweeper cover
from round the stumps, Vijay is again down the track and drags the intended big hit to deep midwicket
skips down the track, picks the length delivery turning into him and swings it over square-leg boundary
leans across to push the off break through cover point
skips down the track and works it towards deep midwicket
moves down the track and moves outside leg stump and drives to sweeper cover
from round the stumps, floats it in full, pushed back to KP
eases this towards long-on and again by the time the fielder rushes in, he picks his second run to complete his half-century
stays back to work this short-of-length delivery to midwicket
the sharp bouncer, Raina takes his eyes off the ball, has an ungainly fend at it and the ball flies past the bat and his head
outside off stump, full in length, run down to third man
taps it to right of square-leg and Vinay moves to his right to stop
fullish delivery, Raina flicks uppishly and gets it past the diving fielder
stays back to inside edge the slider from outside off to the on side

Whaddaplayaaaaaaa! It was the googly that did the trick for him. Hayden charged out for the big hit, Kumble flighted it, also slowed it up wonderfully,  got it to dip and it broke away from Hayden, who was looking to swing to midwicket, and Robin completed the stumping.
leans forward to defend a length delivery back to Anil
on the middle and off line, pushed down towards long-on and by the time the fielder comes in from the deep, they take 2
on the middle and leg, squeezed to square-leg
on the middle stump line, flicked past square-leg
moves outside leg for the big hit and drags the slower one to long-on
gets forward to flick it midwicket
length delivery, jabbed to the on side
It was the slower one, full in length, Haydos got forward, head down, and swung it over long-on! he didn't even look up as he completed the shot
stays in line to push it to the on side for a single
moves outside leg stump and goes for a big slog .. no wood on leather. Robin collects
a sharp pacy bouncer on the middle stump line, Hayden sways away from the line of fire
length delivery on the middle stump line, eased to the on side
short in length and outside off stump, punched to point where Virat, who is speaking to the tv comms, makes a complete mess of a regulation stop
short delivery into the ribcage, jabbed to square-leg
slower one outside off stump, pushed to point for a quick run
around 146 kmph full in length on the middle, dragged past square-leg
around off and middle line, Hayden gets forward to tap it to the off side for a quick single
on the off and middle, pushed back to Anil
tow-fingered googly outside leg stump, shoveled to short fine-leg
moves down the track, Kumble gets to skid it on from short of length and Vijay inside edges it wide of short fine-leg
another slider around off and middle, Hayden gets a leading edge to cover
slider outside off stump, Hayden is beaten, pushing inside the line
Flamboyantly played pick-up shot over square-leg! He whipped the length delivery from the middle and leg up and over the boundary. Very stylishly done.
PK errs by slipping this one down the leg side and Vijay flicks it past short fine-leg fielder
picks the slower one from the off stump line and dismisses it over wide long-on boundary. Imperious. Nonchalantly dragged across.
fetches the short of length delivery from outside off and whips to to deep backward square-leg
Bangs in a bouncer just outside off and Vijay top edges the pull shot but luckily for him, it flies to fine-leg !
around the off stump line, pushed out to cover
Vijay stays back again to a full delivery and pushes it to cover
Screamer! It kicked up from a short of length and burst past Vijay's defensive poke and Robin collects it near his left shoulder
length delivery outside off stump, Hayden lets it go, the ball bounces before it reaches Robin who doesn't stop it cleanly ..
full delivery, Vijay stays back - perhaps he was expecting a short one- and edges the square drive to third man
hits the length this time, around off stump line, pushed out to cover
overpitches it down the leg side, free gift, and Vijay flicks it away to square-leg boundary
another lifting delivery, Vijay stays back to tap it down to the off side for a quick single
bangs it in short outside off, Vijay sways away
short in length and outside off stump, Vijay punches on the up and through covers
this one curves in to the middle stump line, wrists it through midwicket and KP sets off in pursuit
around the off and middle line, squeezed out to point
just outside off stump, Vijay eases it to cover
